label: api-stuck-process-observation
mode: read-only /proc observation through the exact approved instance; no signal, no write
interpretation: Process identity unchanged from the preflight binding. The process is alive with no exit code. None of its 8 open file descriptors matches a row in /proc/net/tcp: the process owns zero TCP connections, including no database socket. The remaining descriptors are files, pipes, eventfd/eventpoll and non-TCP sockets, consistent with an event loop held open by timer and internal handles rather than by any network connection.
